reason: A DSH web toolbox that combines local conversation and plugin management, interface enhancements, usage reporting, desktop notifications, service restart controls, and an optional WeChat gateway with media and AI API integrations; human review is appropriate because it includes destructive operations, plugin mutation, external account access, and credential handling.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH web 提供会话与插件管理、界面增强、用量统计、桌面通知及可选微信接入等多种工具。
summaries.en: A DSH web toolbox offering conversation and plugin management, interface enhancements, usage reporting, desktop notifications, and optional WeChat integration.

capabilities: Persists feature configuration in local profile files
Deletes individual or multiple archived conversations
Enables, disables, updates, and uninstalls installed plugins
Restarts the DSH web service and refreshes the page
Aggregates session usage and estimates costs from local logs
Connects a personal WeChat account to DSH Agent sessions
Transfers WeChat media and optionally uses external ASR, vision, and image-generation APIs
